summary: Teams act as office staff to produce a variety of business documents. Contestants collaborate to create, manage, and format documents using specified formats. All work is completed on-site and uploaded electronically.
time_limits: no more than ten (10) minutes orientation
no more than sixty (60) minutes testing time
no more than ten (10) minutes wrap-up
submission_requirements: All student-produced jobs completed on-site are uploaded electronically and are not printed at the national level
Flash drive (one per team, which must be submitted with test materials at conclusion of testing)
what_to_bring: Published and/or unpublished non-electronic written reference materials
competencies: Create, manage and format business documents through collaboration following specified formats provided in the BPA Style & Reference Manual
Apply technical skills to manage information and produce business documents
Evaluate and delegate responsibilities needed to perform required tasks
Plan and manage projects by establishing work priorities and timelines
Demonstrate teamwork skills needed to function as an office staff
Manage digital and physical output, including exporting PDF files
Proofread and edit to ensure accuracy and consistency
judging_notes: AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed
eligibility_notes: Any middle level contestant may enter this application team event
A team will consist of 2 -4 contestants
